title: OutputEnvelopePayload
description: The envelope every command prints: `ok`, `command`, `version`, then `payload` on success or `diagnostics` and `errors` on failure. Mirrors `OutputDTO`; `payload` is the per-command schema named `<command>.json` beside this file.

ErrorReportPayload.description: One entry of the top-level `errors[]` on an `ok:false` envelope (ADR-053). Deliberate mirror of `srs_repository::ErrorReport`: schemars is not a dependency of srs-repository (ADR-011).

details.description: Open object of variant-specific fields, when the error has any.
